mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at historically low levels (below 2.0%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to compressed discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and 5-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 250.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering equity market risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500000.0, the market anticipates restrictive monetary policy compressing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rising and RSAFS > 500000.0 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high demand growth regimes (GDPC1 > 2.0% quarterly and HOUST > 1200.0), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 2.0% and HOUST > 1200.0 and 5-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at historically low levels (below 2.0%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and 20-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 250.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering equity market risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 250.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is accelerating and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, the economy enters a soft landing phase, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rising and INDPRO < 105.0 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in potential monetary policy easing.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 40% of instances.
